sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to all Medicare Advantage products and for network provider services reported using the UB04 and CMS 1500 form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form.

children.title: Overview
children.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for fecal calprotectin testing associated with non-inflammatory gastrointestinal disease (e.g., IBS) or inflammatory gastrointestinal disease (e.g., IBD).

children.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
children.content: NOTE: Procedure codes appearing in policy documents are included only as a general reference tool for each policy. They may not be all-inclusive. UnitedHealthcare will consider reimbursement for fecal calprotectin testing when billed for any of the conditions listed below: Procedure Code(s) 83993 Condition(s) a. Non-inflammatory gastrointestinal disease (e.g., IBS) b. Inflammatory gastrointestinal disease (e.g., IBD) UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the fecal calprotectin procedure code above for any other conditions.
